kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استعجلن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَلْنَ (istaʕjalna) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اُسْتُعْجِلْنَ (ustuʕjilna) /us.tuʕ.d͡ʒil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اِسْتَعْجِلْنَ (istaʕjilna) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
